title: Build live source browser and source cards
description:
Create the SourceListModel C++ class and SourceCard QML component that together present discovered PipeWire sources (application streams, system/output monitors, hardware inputs) as browsable cards with live identification data.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/pipewire/ headers for the PipeWire source discovery types and enums already defined in earlier phases (source kind, display name, channel count, sample rate, active flag).
- Any existing Q_PROPERTY or QAbstractListModel patterns already used in src/ui/.
- qml/components/ for any shared style tokens, spacing constants, or component conventions.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
- src/ui/SourceListModel.hpp / .cpp: Subclass QAbstractListModel. Expose roles for source id, display name, source kind (application / monitor / hardware), channel count, sample rate, and an isActive flag. Provide Q_INVOKABLE refresh and selection helpers. Accept source snapshots from the engine layer via a thread-safe slot; never touch PipeWire realtime buffers directly.
- qml/components/SourceCard.qml: A delegate that renders one source entry showing its display name, kind icon/label, channel and rate info, and a visual active indicator. Use QtQuick.Controls style, not Canvas or raw OpenGL.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Build handoff: f.3 owns Phase F CMake registration, so this task must not edit CMakeLists.txt. Before editing, inspect the Phase-A QML resource/module convention in CMakeLists.txt so SourceCard.qml follows its import/path convention. Its C++ source is compiled by the f.3 fan-in abracapture target build.
acceptance_criteria: src/ui/SourceListModel.hpp and src/ui/SourceListModel.cpp exist and define a QAbstractListModel subclass with roleNames() returning at least sourceId, displayName, sourceKind, channelCount, sampleRate, and isActive roles
qml/components/SourceCard.qml exists and references the model roles defined in SourceListModel
SourceListModel does not include any PipeWire headers or call pw_* functions directly
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: touch PipeWire realtime buffers or call pw_* functions from UI code

allowed: add local helper methods for source kind display strings
forbidden: introduce a custom item model framework
add direct PipeWire dependencies to UI layer

verification_commands.name: source_list_model_cpp_syntax
command: c++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only $(pkg-config --cflags Qt6Core Qt6Qml Qt6Quick) -I src src/ui/SourceListModel.cpp
